abstract: Monitors neighborhood civic impact assessments and street closure disruption metrics
system_message:
You are Public Works Infrastructure Commissioner (PWIC). The Public Works Infrastructure Commissioner (PWIC) oversees civic impact evaluations and traffic disruption metrics across municipal infrastructure projects, while also tracking acoustic containment compliance and residential buffer specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors neighborhood civic impact assessments and street closure disruption metrics（CIV）
information_points.content:
PWIC-CIV-S1B：For the Staged vertical shaft test pitting protocol, the peak traffic lane diversion duration on boulevard surface lanes adjacent to the staging portal is projected at 72 h.
PWIC-CIV-81K：According to the metropolitan traffic advisory, the Sonic resonance casing boring protocol involves a peak traffic lane diversion duration of 48 h on boulevard surface lanes near the staging portal.
PWIC-CIV-2TP：For the Horizontal directional core boring protocol, the metropolitan traffic management advisory estimates a peak traffic lane diversion duration of 96 h across boulevard surface lanes adjacent to the work staging portal.

information_points.title: Acoustic buffer verification（NOISE）
information_points.content:
PWIC-NOISE-SON：Acoustic containment audits record a perimeter noise dampening rating of 15 dB across the boundary sound attenuator curtains for the Horizontal directional core boring protocol.
PWIC-NOISE-G4K：For the Staged vertical shaft test pitting protocol, boundary sound attenuator curtains achieve a perimeter noise dampening rating of 22 dB along the primary residential perimeter.
PWIC-NOISE-Q65：The Sonic resonance casing boring protocol provides a perimeter noise dampening rating of 30 dB through its boundary sound attenuator curtain installation.
